newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait ministries' complex evacuated in bomb scare.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait ministries' complex evacuated in bomb scare.

text.p: Kuwaiti authorities evacuated a busy government complex in a hoax bomb scare, the second in a week, newspapers reported on Sunday.
The dailies said the ministries' complex in central Kuwait City was evacuated on Saturday after receiving three telephone warnings of a bomb.
Earlier in the week the Sultan Center supermarket, used by many Western residents, was evacuated in a similar scare.
No bombs were found in either case, security sources said.
In late October the U.S. embassy warned American citizens to exercise particular caution in light of reported threats against U.S. interests in Kuwait.
The U.S. military in the Moslem conservative Gulf Arab region has been on a state of high security alert since last November's bomb attack in neighbouring Saudi Arabia, officials say.
In the past year 24 Americans and two Indians were killed in two separate bomb attacks against U.S. military interests in the kingdom.
